No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic CREATURE in the sky.\pIt seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.\pBy the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.\pWere you on MUSTAFAR or something?$
The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pBRIGHT TREE VILLAGE exists because\nthere's both water and soil.$

The village is made of huts built
high in the trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.$
There are CREATURES that evolve when\nyou trade them! That's what I heard.$
BRIGHT TREE VILLAGE\n“The treetop home of the EWOKS.”$
BRIGHT TREE ARENA\nLEADER: CHIRPA\p“The EWOK chief who rides the\nforest winds.”$
Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own terminal.\pThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.$
Trading CREATURES with others…\pIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.$
People… CREATURES…\pTheir hidden powers are awoken by\nliving close to the Force…$
Let this old woman see if your hidden\npower has awoken…\pI hold a credit chip in my hand.\pNow, tell me, have I palmed it in\nthe right hand? Or in the left?$
Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the chip?\nThe right or left?$
Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the chip?\nThe right or left?$
Oh! Splendid!\nYour hidden power has awoken!\pHere, take this and awaken the hidden\npower of your CREATURES.$

While speaking about DATAPADS,
I remembered something.\pI met this TRAINER, LEIA, when
I was searching for rare crystals.\pHoo, boy, she had some amazing
CREATURES with her.\pThey weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!\pShe might even be stronger than the
ARENA LEADER in this village…$
By being together with CREATURES,\npeople make more and more friends.\pAnd that brings the galaxy closer\ntogether. I think it's wonderful!$
The tree huts of BRIGHT TREE are great!\pI think it's the number one village for\nliving together with CREATURES.$
CREATURES and people have adapted to\nnature for survival.\pThere's no need to make nature\nconform to the way we want to live.$
A POWER RATION makes a CREATURE grow\nimmediately by one level.$
Listen, kid, are you working\non a DATAPAD?\pHmm… Fly to the FELUCIA RESERVE.\nThat's my suggestion.$

Yo, how's it going, ILUM-bound
{PLAYER}?\pBRIGHT TREE ARENA LEADER CHIRPA is
a master of FLYING-type CREATURES.\pHe's waiting at the back of this ARENA,
behind the rotating doors.\pHe's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!\pOkay, go for it!$
CHIEF CHIRPA is wise and strong.\nHe's the ultimate LEADER!\pYub nub!$
Thanks to CHIRPA, the EWOKS of\nBRIGHT TREE can live without fear.$
When CHIRPA takes to battle, his face\nshines with fierce determination…\pI'm not letting you witness that\nproud sight!$

I am CHIRPA. I am the chief of
BRIGHT TREE VILLAGE and its ARENA.\pI have become one with BIRD CREATURES
and have glided over the forest…\pHowever grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace…\pWitness the elegant flight of
my BIRD CREATURES and I!$
notes: Chief Chirpa is male; arena is in his village

sw_text_raw: Never before have I seen a TRAINER\ncommand CREATURES with more grace\lthan I…\pIn recognition of your prowess,\nI present to you this ARENA SHARD.$
Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to BIRD CREATURES.$

CHIRPA: We EWOKS can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have passed the TRIALS
OF ILUM.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!$

CHIRPA: We EWOKS can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have passed the TRIALS
OF ILUM.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!\pOh, no… Do you have but one
CREATURE with you?\pPlease return with two CREATURES
at the very least.$
Behold the elegant battle style of\nBIRD CREATURES!$

LEIA: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pIt's me, LEIA!
We met in the SHADOWLANDS.\pHave you met many kinds of CREATURES
since I last saw you?\pThere are so many kinds of CREATURES
in this wide galaxy of ours.\pIf you wanted to raise only your
favorites, that's fine.\pPerhaps you find it more fun to raise
all sorts of CREATURES.\pAs a TRAINER of CREATURES,
what do you think?\pOf course, it's not any of my business.\pIt would be nice if we were to meet
again somewhere.$
Even if there isn't a boat, you can\ncross rivers and lakes if you have\la CREATURE that knows SURF.\pCREATURES can be counted on to do so\nmuch!$
ROUTE 118\n{LEFT_ARROW} HANGAR TO TATOOINE$
Flowers, CREATURES…\nI love whatever smells nice.\pStinky things…\nI'll pass.$
You've got great CREATURES.\nI'll have to train mine better.$
I couldn't win by training CREATURES\nwhile I fished…\pWas I doing things in half measures?$
For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\pBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare CREATURES and heart, of course!$
If you use a sweet aroma properly,\nCREATURES will be attracted by it.$

KAEL: {PLAYER}! So this is where
you've been looking for CREATURES?\pLet me see how good you got.
I'll test you!\pNow!
It's a battle, so battle!$
KAEL: I'd say you're good enough\nto search for CREATURES anywhere.\pHere, I'll give you this.\nTry it out.$

MIRA: Use FLY, and your CREATURE will
instantly carry you to any town you've\lalready visited.\pBut, to use FLY, you have to get
the ARENA SHARD from BRIGHT TREE.\lThat's important, so don't forget.\pYou should FLY home to
MOS PELGO for a change.\pI bet your mom's worried about you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere!$
We're standing lookout here.\pHey, you! Stay away from ENDOR\nSTATION. It's not safe.$
Tch…\nIt's a no-go…\pThe ferns snag a BIKE's repulsors.\nThere's no way you can ride here.$
Can your CREATURE use its SECRET POWER\non a big pile of ferns and make a\lHIDEOUT?$
I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with CREATURES.$
Believe in your CREATURES.\nBelieve in yourself.\pThe road will reveal itself to you.$
How's your journey with CREATURES\ngoing?$
In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your CREATURES, your CREATURES\lrely on you.$
I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD CREATURES!$
To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a CREATURE, use CREATURES!\pThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.$
I heard about a place called the\nCAVE OF ORIGIN.\pPeople rumor that the spirits of\nCREATURES are revived there. Could\lsomething like that really happen?$
JABBA got interested in the\nresearch they have going here,\lso he sent us out.\pYou quit meddling!$
The mighty JABBA knows everything.\pBut I'm just a THUG. What would I know\nabout what he's thinking?$
Wow, you're really strong!\pI wish I could be a CREATURE TRAINER\nlike you!$

The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.\pBut if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.\pAnd thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.$
On the 2nd floor of the STATION,\nwe study the weather patterns over\lthe OUTER RIM region.\pWe've been noticing temporary and\nisolated cases of droughts and\lheavy rain lately…$
Hello!\nWe've been saved by your actions!\pWhat I don't understand is what in the\ngalaxy the CARTEL was up to.$
The STATION built a type of\nCREATURE that has something to do with\lthe weather. We're here to take it!$
If the CREATURE they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of\lthe CARTEL definitely need it!$
We're the CARTEL!\nWe show up wherever anything rare\lis found!$
You don't have any idea what we of\nthe CARTEL are working towards!\lYou stay out of our way!$

Hssssss!\pYou're going to meddle in the CARTEL's
affairs?\pYou're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!\pBOSSK has hunted bigger prey.
You'll make a fine trophy, kiddy!$
Hssss!\nYou're disgustingly strong!$
It's bad enough to have the EMPIRE\nblunder about, but now there's you!\pWhat makes you want to sniff around\nin our business, anyway?$
We have a situation here!\pAn EMPIRE shuttle just flew past\nENDOR STATION.\pIt appears to be headed for the\nJEDHA TEMPLE!$
What?!\pWe can't waste any more time here!\nWe have to hurry to JEDHA, too!\pHssssss!\nEMPIRE, just you wait!$
That CREATURE changes shape according\nto the weather conditions.\pThere're plenty of them at the\nSTATION--go ahead and take it.$
KAEL: Use FLY, and your CREATURE\ninstantly carries you to any town\lyou've already visited.\pBut you need the ARENA SHARD from\nBRIGHT TREE to do that.\pAnyway, I have to move along.$

LANDO: Hahahah!
Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI just passed by a TRAINER riding
a BIKE.\pYou just beat that TRAINER, didn't you?
It was pretty obvious that you did.\pThe kid looked really upset with
a face all red from anger.\pI sure seem to run into you often.
Are you off to BRIGHT TREE ARENA next?\pI expect you'll do well at the ARENA.
Well, I'll be seeing you!$
{PLAYER} used the INCOM SCOPE.\pAn invisible CREATURE became fully\nvisible!\pThe startled CREATURE fled!$
LEIA used the INCOM SCOPE.\pAn invisible CREATURE became fully\nvisible!\pThe startled CREATURE attacked!$

LEIA: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi.
It's been a while.\pThere's something here that you can't
see, right?\pNow, if I were to use this device on
the invisible obstacle…\pNo, no. Rather than describing it,
I should just show you.\lThat would be more fun.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, are your CREATURES ready
for battle?$
LEIA: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your CREATURES\nready for battle?$

LEIA: I see…
Your battle style is intriguing.\pYour CREATURES have obviously grown
since I first met you on KASHYYYK.\pI'd like you to have this
INCOM SCOPE.\pWho knows, there may be other
concealed CREATURES.$
LEIA: {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI enjoy seeing CREATURES and TRAINERS\nwho strive together.\pI think you're doing great.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere.$
I'll check your CREATURES and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.$
With CREATURES that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!$
Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my CREATURES.$
… … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…\lFor my precious BUG CREATURES…$
A parasol can't ward off CREATURE\nattacks…$
I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my CREATURES.\lSo I shield them with my parasol.$
I will copy the moves of CREATURES\nand create new ninja techniques.$
Should I evolve my CREATURES?\nThey're cute the way they are, though.$
I think it's awesome you're so strong\nbattling with your favorite CREATURES.$
FRUIT grows by soaking up sunlight.\pWe help the FRUIT grow by watering\nit regularly.\pIt's an expression of love, isn't it?$
Okay!\nWe're to fly out to JEDHA!$
Shuttles from this pad fly to JEDHA…\pIts TEMPLE is a monument to the\nspirits of departed CREATURES…$
notes: Route 121's pier is a shuttle pad to Jedha (net:hangar rows)

sw_text_raw: SHUTTLE PAD: JEDHA TEMPLE\p…The sign is old and worn out.\nThe words are barely legible…$
“Filled with rare CREATURES!”\nSHUTTLE TO THE FELUCIA RESERVE$
I'm going to a SHOWCASE in CLOUD CITY.\pMy CREATURES should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.$
With my CREATURES, I have traveled\nto the galaxy's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$
With my CREATURES, I have traveled\nto the galaxy's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$
I would like to cross the galaxy once\nagain with my CREATURES.$
Your CREATURES and you…\pYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even off-world.$
JOA: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KESS,\nmy senior student partner, again.$
Maybe I'll go catch more CREATURES at\nthe RESERVE.$
Maybe I'll go catch more CREATURES at\nthe RESERVE.$
There's nothing I love more than\nchecking out other people's CREATURES!$
They're great, your CREATURES!\nHow do you raise them?$
I bought too much stuff at\nthe CLOUD CITY DEPT. STORE.\pIt's a short flight from here.\nI wish I had a BAG like yours.$

Welcome to the FELUCIA RESERVE
SHUTTLE!\pOn FELUCIA, you may see many kinds
of CREATURES rarely seen out here.\pAnd, you'll see them in their wild,
untamed state in natural habitats.\pWhat's more, the gates are open
to CREATURE TRAINERS.\pYou're encouraged to catch CREATURES
for keeps!\pCome in and enjoy the FELUCIA RESERVE!$
notes: Safari Zone entrance = shuttle office to the Felucia Reserve

sw_text_raw: When you enter the RESERVE, you\nstart with 30 SAFARI PODS for\lcatching CREATURES.\pThe SAFARI Game is over when you run\nout of SAFARI PODS, or when you've\lwalked 500 steps.\pCome in and enjoy the FELUCIA RESERVE!$
Welcome to the FELUCIA RESERVE!\pAll you can catch for 500 credits!\nWould you like to play a SAFARI Game?$
That will be 500 credits, please.$
Excuse me!\nYour storage BOX is full.$
I love GRASS-type CREATURES!\pDo you have any GRASS-type CREATURES?$
I check trees with my GRASS-type\nCREATURES. I'm like a tree doctor.$
{UP_ARROW} SHUTTLE PAD: JEDHA TEMPLE\n“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”$
Don't be too happy if your CREATURES\ndevelop psychic powers.\pYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.$
JEDHA TEMPLE…\nWhere the spirits of CREATURES sleep…\lWill your CREATURES sleep?$
JEDHA TEMPLE…\nWhere the spirits of CREATURES sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$
I gather BIRD CREATURE feathers that\nscatter during battles.\pI'm going to make a hat with\nBIRD CREATURE feathers.$
When there are no TRAINERS around,\nI let my CREATURES battle each other.\lI watch them.$
I kind of like your CREATURES.$
Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near BESTINE\lon TATOOINE.\pLet flowers fill the world!$
Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\pJoy never goes out of my life!$
I want to go to the ARENA,\nbut something's blocking the way.\pAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120…$
I've got my pride-and-joy CREATURE\nwith me. This time, I'll beat CHIRPA.$
Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG CREATURES come in\nthrough windows.\lIt can be really startling.$
Something unseeable is in the way.$
Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the INCOM SCOPE?$
I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\pIf I don't, when I decorate my\nHIDEOUT, my DOLLS will get\ldirty or poked with splinters.$
You did it!\nYou've achieved liftoff!$
You…\nYou're strong…$
A TRAINER has to be smart to keep\nup with unexpected turns of events.\pDo you have the smarts to get to\nour LEADER?$
The lovers of BIRD CREATURES aspire\nto join this ARENA.\pAs a member of the BRIGHT TREE ARENA,\nI'm not allowed to lose!$
It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…$
The world is huge, and there are\ncountless tough TRAINERS.\pI'm going to keep training and make\nmyself even stronger.$
There's no need for CHIRPA, our ARENA\nLEADER, to deal with you!\pI'm plenty good enough for you!$
CHIRPA, I…\nI lost!$
CHIRPA taught me personally!\nYou can't beat me easily!$
I was beaten…$
Urk!\nI couldn't stop you.$
You'd better watch it!\nDon't get distracted staring at CHIRPA\lor you'll go crashing down in a heap!$
You'd better know that there are all\nsorts of FLYING-type CREATURES.\pYou do know that, right?$
You seem to know your stuff!$
Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you'd better watch it! Our LEADER\lCHIRPA's CREATURES are all business.$
{PLAYER} received the CANOPY SHARD\nfrom CHIRPA.$

With the CANOPY SHARD, all CREATURES up
to LV 70, even those received through\ltrades, will obey your every command.\pYou will also be able to use
the HM move FLY outside of battle.\pAnd this…
This is a gift from me.$
TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.\pIts speed…\nNo CREATURE should be able to avoid it.\p… … … … … …$

BRIGHT TREE ARENA$

I failed to reach your height again…$
CHIRPA: Even though I have lost,\nthe wings of my heart remain unbroken.\pI can rise and soar again and\nyet again.\pI am convinced of it!$

Wrooooaaar! I need it!
I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}!\lI'll do anything for it!\p…Uh… Did you hear that?
My shout from the bottom of my heart?\pHaving heard that, you will trade
your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2},\lwon't you?$
Oh, yeah, right on!\p{STR_VAR_1}, welcome!\n{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$

I'm going to make GLOWFLY super\nstrong from this moment on!\pI hope you do the same with PIT DROID!$

have it.$

I always stock up on more items than\nI'm sure I'll need.\pYou never know what might happen.\nBetter to be safe than sorry!$

Have you done anything at
the RECORD CORNER?\pIt's pretty neat. It mixes and matches
the records of TRAINERS.\pI don't know quite how it works,
but it's cool. It's exciting, even!$

MATCH CALL system?\pAccess it, and you can chat with
registered TRAINERS anytime.\pIt also shows you which TRAINERS
want a rematch with you.\pIt's really nifty! Those INCOM guys
sure know what they're doing!$
Hmm!\nA GOOD ROD is really good!\pWouldn't you agree?$
Hmm!\nWe're of identical minds!\pHmm!\nTake this GOOD ROD!$

Don't you like to fish?$
